items.title: 5.6 Strain energy in deformed materials (bigre hue materials mein strain energy) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6 with Figs. 5.6 and 5.7 (PDF 99-100).

blocks.text: Jab force kisi object ko deform karti hai (us ki shakal ya lambai badalti hai) to elastic restoring force (wapas asal halat mein lane wali force) ke khilaf kaam (work) hota hai. Yeh kaam object mein potential energy ban kar jama ho jata hai. Yeh energy molecules ki potential energy mein increase ke barabar hai, jo molecules ke apni mean positions (average jagahon) se hatne ki wajah se hota hai.
